svg.title: Discrete Nervous System
svg.desc: A spline is sampled into local normals. Interfering magnitude functions stretch each normal; negative phases vanish to open gaps, while four modulo-folded loops retain their alternate histories. Sixteen trajectories become a nervous mesh.
